questions.question_text: What is profit in the context of a side hustle?

options.text: The total money you earn from sales
The money you spend on materials and supplies
The money left after subtracting expenses from income
The money you save for personal goalsCorrect Answer:c) The money left after subtracting expenses from income

questions.question_text: What does reinvesting mean for a teen entrepreneur?

options.text: Spending all your profit on personal items like gadgets
Putting money back into your hustle to grow it, like buying better tools
Saving all your earnings in a bank without using them
Giving money to friends to help with their hustlesCorrect Answer:b) Putting money back into your hustle to grow it, like buying better tools

questions.question_text: Which of the following is a simple way for a teen to track their hustle’s finances?

options.text: Ignoring small transactions since they don’t matter
Using a notebook to write down income and expenses
Guessing how much money is earned or spent each month
Only checking bank statements once a yearCorrect Answer:b) Using a notebook to write down income and expenses

questions.question_text: In India, when might a teen hustler need to worry about income tax?

options.text: If they earn less than ₹1,000 per year from their hustle
If their total yearly income exceeds ₹2.5 lakh
If they sell only one product online
If they use a free app to track moneyCorrect Answer:b) If their total yearly income exceeds ₹2.5 lakh
